<!-- pr-reviewer: b9d5aebc51fa6aaefd3809885a00ae1e4206d16f -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Thanks @tbrasselle - the `job.rs` conflict is resolved the way we asked (both `wire` and `unit` kept in `GenJob`).

**What looks good**
- `GenJob.unit` is read once in `collect_job` (`crates/app/src/operation/job.rs`) and threaded to the worker-thread refusals; no World access added on workers.
- Millimeter documents are byte-identical: all the existing sentence-pin suites pass unmodified.
- No unwrap/expect/panic in non-test code of the diff; touches only `camcraft-app`; no build.rs, scripts, `.github`, process files, deps, snapshot PNGs or CHANGELOG edits.
- Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #740`; conventional commit subjects.

**Local results (PR head trial-merged with current upstream main, clean merge, macOS)**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib`: 148 passed
- Integration binaries, all green: `units_in_refusals` 5, `drill_reach` 6, `drill_reach_fit` 3, `drilling_cross_holder` 2, `drilling_cross_spindle` 7, `drilling_cross_stock` 8, `drilling_cross_rapids` 2, `drilling_axial` 7, `drilling_cross` 9, `drilling_cross_box` 7, `drilling_cross_part` 3, `drill_prior` 12, `drill_prior_kinds` 4, `drill_rplane` 8, `lathe_cross_drill` 5, `circular_pick` 4, `pick_agnostic` 5 (2 ignored), `pick` 9, `probe_pick` 9, `area_controls` 13, `area_open` 10, `area_picks` 5, `refusal_location` 3, `wire_contour` 7, `feature_pick_wire` 4 (1 ignored)
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Wire EDM refusals added on main (`wire_op.rs`) print no mm quantities, so nothing was missed there.
- Other refusals outside this PR's scope still hardcode mm, e.g. chamfer/cone messages in `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:957, 1781, 1792`, `tool_gate.rs:126`, `machine/mod.rs:254-260`. Worth a follow-up issue if #740 is meant to cover all generators.
- `crates/app/tests/units_in_refusals.rs` is 535 lines (over the ~400 guideline; a new file, so a split by refusal family would be tidy) and `drill_reach.rs` is 448 lines (grew by this PR). Not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
